messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, I want to book a one-way flight from New York to Seattle on May 20.

Sure, my user ID is mia_li_3668.
Thank you. For the one-way flight from New York to Seattle on May 20, could you please specify the cabin class you prefer? The options are basic economy, economy, or business.
I would like to fly in economy class.
How many passengers will be traveling? For each passenger, I will need their first name, last name, and date of birth. The maximum number of passengers per reservation is five.
It’s just me traveling. My name is Mia Li. You can find my date of birth in my user profile.
Do you want to add travel insurance for your flight? The insurance costs $30 and allows full refund if you need to cancel due to health or weather reasons.
No, I do not want to add travel insurance.

Please provide the payment method you would like to use for this booking. It can be a credit card, gift card, or travel certificate already stored in your user profile. Also, please confirm if you want any checked baggage for your flight. As an economy class passenger, you have 1 free checked bag included.
I want to use my two travel certificates to pay. I have 3 checked bags for this trip.

You want to book a one-way economy class flight from New York to Seattle on May 20 for one passenger named Mia Li. You do not want travel insurance. You want to pay using two travel certificates from your profile. You want 3 checked bags for this trip.

Please confirm if all the details are correct and if you want me to proceed with the booking.
Yes, all the details are correct. Please proceed with the booking.
